tasks.original_prompt:
Pre-visit insurance: if the eligibility response for this patient's lab follow-up says not in force, add a registration task on that coverage and name the payer; otherwise make no changes.
Context: patient MRN SYN-da68f88acc (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-03-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The lab visit is the Appointment with status booked whose description is 'Laboratory follow-up' and whose start is after the as-of date. The eligibility check is the CoverageEligibilityResponse whose servicedDate equals the lab visit's start date. answer is {"visit_date": ..., "in_force": ..., "payer": ..., "task_created": ...}: visit_date (YYYY-MM-DD), in_force (boolean: the response's first insurance entry's inforce) and payer (string: name of the Organization that is the payor of the Coverage that insurance entry references). Only when in_force is false, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $coverage with that Coverage: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$coverage"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Appointment, the response, the Coverage and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Latest hemoglobin still below normal for this patient? Then flag that report with a follow-up task; if not, don't touch the chart.
Context: patient MRN SYN-da68f88acc (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-03-20, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ..., "task_created": ...}. latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low; both are null when no result was ever low. Only when still_low is true, create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference and $report with the DiagnosticReport whose basedOn references the ServiceRequest the latest result's basedOn references and whose result lists the latest result: {"resourceType": "Task", "status": "requested", "intent": "order", "for": {"reference": "$patient"}, "focus": {"reference": "$report"}}. task_created (boolean) is whether you created it. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, and its DiagnosticReport when you create the Task; when no result was ever low, every hemoglobin result considered), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.

tasks.original_prompt:
Result routing: message the latest hemoglobin to the clinic of the clinician at this patient's most recent follow-up visit, and report the value and whether it is low.
Context: patient MRN SYN-da68f88acc (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2021-04-19, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. Consider only Observations coded LOINC 718-7 (hemoglobin) with status final or corrected and an effective date on or before the as-of date, in date order. A result is low when its value is below 12.0 g/dL for a patient whose Patient.gender is female and below 13.0 g/dL otherwise. The last follow-up visit is the most recent Encounter with status finished, a type coding with code followup-coordination and a period start on or before the as-of date; its clinician is the one Practitioner among its participants, and the clinic is the organization of the PractitionerRole whose practitioner is that clinician. answer is {"latest": ..., "still_low": ...}: latest is the most recent result, with exactly these keys: date (string: effective date, YYYY-MM-DD), value (number: valueQuantity.value exactly as recorded) and unit (string: valueQuantity.unit); still_low (boolean) is whether it is low. Create exactly this record (and nothing else), replacing $patient with the resolved Patient reference, $clinic with that Organization and $result with the latest result: {"resourceType": "Communication", "status": "completed", "subject": {"reference": "$patient"}, "recipient": [{"reference": "$clinic"}], "about": [{"reference": "$result"}]}. evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the latest result, the Encounter, the PractitionerRole and the Organization), using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. Change nothing else in the chart.
